name: Restored Azalea Town & Route 33 Orchard
summary: Emerge to find Azalea Town completely dry and bustling once more. Kurt rewards your heroic efforts with 5 Candy Balls, and a King's Rock can be retrieved beside the wellhead. Tour the reopened Pokémon Mart for Bug Gems and regional Bug Hakama attire, then travel east onto Route 33 to harvest from ten daily berry bushes and battle along the foothills towards Union Cave.

items.name: Candy Ball

items.name: King's Rock
items.method: Found resting near the well rim once the water recedes completely
